this was a great quote from Gavin Baker on Seides' podcast in March:

"Everything is downstream of Buffett. In the English language, 99% of good quotes are from Shakespeare, 1% are from Winston Churchill, and there's essentially nothing else...In investing, Buffett is 95%. And then there's Peter Lynch's 4%. Then a bunch of other people for the 1%."

--

💯 on both Shakespeare + Buffett, as well as the broad analogue
